name: quipclipper
overview: quipclipper's clips, named by their line
description: Shows the clips quipclipper cuts by their line instead of their file name, with the source episode's still or the movie's poster, an overview of where and when the line is from, the show as a tag, and the day it was cut. It reads the metadata sidecar quipclipper writes beside every clip: no network, no account. Point a Home Videos library at quipclipper's clips folder. https://github.com/weckere/jellyfin-plugin-quipclipper
